purpose: Merged contract: populates traceable screen values from the 2026-09-29 numeric handoff into the original contract schema. Fields the handoff itself leaves open remain null -- nothing has been inferred or filled beyond what was supplied.

selected_screen_basis.name: latest_CAD_A2_reference_screen
selected_screen_basis.cross_check: alpha_self_heating_ratio and fusion_to_modeled_losses_ratio independently verified against the module power screen (deck slide 5); tau_E figures independently verified against the same source. Both match.

alpha_self_heating.qualification_note: The 0.90 deposition / 0.10 escaped-alpha split is the model branch used to reproduce the screen, not orbit-resolved qualified transport. Keep the qualified replacement (real plasma transport / orbit-loss model) open.

plasma_heating_balance.formula: P_external_laser_absorbed_required = max(0, P_total_absorbed_heating_required - P_alpha_to_plasma - P_RF_absorbed - P_other_absorbed)
plasma_heating_balance.boundary_note: P_RF_absorbed_W and P_other_absorbed_W are zero only because this is the laser-only accounting boundary -- not a claim the full reactor has no RF/auxiliary heating.
plasma_heating_balance.interpretation: Alpha self-heating alone (186.1 MW) exceeds the modeled steady-state loss requirement (155.3 MW) on this screen, so the steady external laser requirement is zero. The laser remains a required transient/startup/perturbation source; no validated transient energy-to-state map exists yet (see pulse_definition_required and remaining_blockers).

laser_conversion_and_wall_loss.eta_laser_to_plasma_nominal_context: EV-009 nominal absorption on a 100 micrometer ramp
laser_conversion_and_wall_loss.eta_laser_to_plasma_optimized_context: EV-009 inverse result at 629.05 micrometer ramp and 2 keV background; validation open
laser_conversion_and_wall_loss.wall_fraction_note: 1 - eta_laser_to_plasma is only an upper bound if every uncoupled joule reaches the liquid wall -- it is NOT the liquid-wall fraction. Still requires beam tracing, aperture-loss accounting, and a resolved target/corona/wall map before use.

other_plasma_facing_surface_sources.rule: Escaped alpha power may be a wall source; deposited alpha self-heating may not be copied into a wall source.

pulse_definition_required.pulse_duration_semantics: long_preconditioning_component_only; the fast spike is stored separately

energy_split.status: OPEN; no fixed split is claimed without a target/source design

alternate_rev2_4_active_profile_case.interpretation: This is the branch that produces a nonzero steady external-laser requirement. Values are rounded from the prior review and must not be combined with the CAD-A2 reference screen above.

mandatory_solver_guards: The 16 port energy fractions must sum to one when shot energy is nonzero.
Deposited alpha self-heating may appear only in the plasma balance.
Escaped alpha power must be derived independently before assignment to a wall boundary.
A transient solve requires a resolved pulse split, timing schedule and per-port allocation.
Peak and cycle-averaged heat fluxes must be stored as different variables.
Do not use wall-plug efficiency as laser-to-plasma efficiency.
Do not use 1 - eta_laser_to_plasma as the liquid-wall fraction.
Do not treat 0.268574 or 0.860024 as qualified coupling.
Do not choose f_pre or f_spike until the source/target design specifies the split.
Keep the selected CAD-A2 balance and the Rev2.4 legacy balance as separate cases.
still_blocking_a_full_solver_launch: fraction_stray_laser_to_liquid_wall (transient wall heat load undefined without it)
beam origins, directions, polarization, focus and spot-size schedule
background bremsstrahlung, synchrotron and other-radiation wall source maps
vendor/facility evidence for 10 Hz, 2.50 MJ/module operation
module-scale wall-plug efficiency and thermal-duty qualification
qualified (orbit-resolved) alpha deposition fraction to replace the 0.90 screen branch
what_is_now_resolved: Steady-state P_external_laser_absorbed_required_W = 0 on the selected CAD-A2 screen (alpha self-heating alone covers modeled losses)
Full laser driver baseline (wavelength, port count, shot energy, repetition rate, average power, per-port energy split)
Both eta_laser_to_plasma values recorded with their model context, correctly labeled as unqualified
Legacy Rev2.4 branch fully computed and kept separate, for reference if that branch is ever reselected
